entrypoint_review.inspection_scope: Relevant top-level source programs in the requested source collection
notes: The pressure-resolved diagnostic entry requires original monthly atmospheric fields, surface pressure, neighboring-temperature months and a pre-existing predictor/control series. Its default launch path submits scheduled work and must not be used as the reusable entry unchanged.
The remapping entry accepts previously diagnosed pressure-resolved heating regressions. It currently binds fixed products, years, analysis labels, region and original reference-manifest layout.
Other inspected candidates cover column heating, plotting, spherical wind diagnostics or operational submission. They do not replace the two LBM thermal-forcing preparation stages.

reusable_model_references.logical_source: Existing production LBM background reused from local result copy
reusable_model_references.distribution: private testing only; not for inclusion in the code package

model_reference_notes: The earlier topography and background-format template are available in the existing private verification snapshot but are not required for thermal-only forcing remapping.
The supplied forcing must use the same model background surface pressure and sigma axis as the intended LBM experiment. A generic template background must not silently replace that model background.
The T42 Gaussian grid can be generated from the numerical/binary helpers. The thermal-forcing binary is written directly and needs no separate real forcing-file template.

scientific_file_contract.target: T42L20: 128 longitude x 64 Gaussian latitude x 20 sigma levels
scientific_file_contract.target_pressure: sigma times the selected model background PS
scientific_file_contract.thermodynamic_units: K day-1 divided by 86400 gives K s-1; energy heating uses the stated Cp before conversion
scientific_file_contract.binary_layout: 61 big-endian Fortran sequential horizontal-plane float32 records: 20 vorticity, 20 divergence, 20 temperature, 1 surface pressure
scientific_file_contract.thermal_only: Vorticity, divergence and surface-pressure forcing records are zero
scientific_file_contract.source_mapping_policy: Signed heating/cooling retained; no vertical integral, amplitude normalization, significance filtering or final global spectral filtering
scientific_file_contract.original_region: 45S to 15N, 30E to 120E; five-degree inner cosine taper; exact exterior zeros
